title: Workflow runtime, preflight và approvals
scope_items: Target 1 (Simulation has no business effects): Implemented PreflightEngine and dry-run execution loop verifying action readiness, credit impact estimation, and platform connector capability without invoking mutations, dispatching side effects, or debiting credit balances.

Target 2 (Changed action invalidates approval): Implemented ComputeActionHash with SHA-256 over node version, RPC name, JSON input payload, target resource objects, and budget quote. Updating workflow versions or modifying action payloads automatically invalidates pending approval requests.

Target 3 (Resume never replays confirmed effect): Implemented idempotent execution tracker in ExecutionEngine; resumed runs verify confirmed side-effect records and bypass already-executed mutation steps, executing only subsequent pending nodes.
Capability-Aware Routing & Degradation: Runtime checks platform capability snapshots before action dispatch; degraded or maintenance platform status triggers fallback node transitions or DLQ pauses.

Approval Expiry & Diagnostics: Timed approvals automatically transition to expired status when expires_at timestamp is reached; DiagnosticsBuilder generates user-facing and operator root-cause explanations.
Dead Letter Queue (DLQ): Fully managed DLQ lifecycle with push, retrieval, payload repair, retry throttling (max retries), and permanent discard.
Cascade Depth Protection (RULE-M20-001): ExecutionEngine enforces maximum trigger cascade depth <= 5, terminating loops with ErrCascadeDepthExceeded.
